subtitle: On-device AI assistant
promotional_text: Chat with AI on your phone. No Wi-Fi required. Free forever. On-device model runs locally — your conversations never leave your device.
description:
AGI runs entirely on your device. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: in v1, every response is generated by an open-source language model running on your device. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
The default model (Qwen3-4B, Apache 2.0) downloads once over Wi-Fi and runs fully local after that. No inference calls hit any server. Your conversations exist only on your device, encrypted in SQLite.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat. Cloud mode (shared chats, more models) is on a waitlist — join from the app.

10+ PROVIDERS WHEN YOU ARE READY
AGI supports Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen, Moonshot Kimi, Perplexity, and more. In v1, on-device models are active. Cloud providers unlock when you join the waitlist.

HEALTH DATA (OPTIONAL)
Connect Apple Health to ask questions about your step count, sleep, and heart rate. All health data stays on your device. AGI is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.

PRIVACY FIRST
We comply with India's DPDP Act 2023 and the EU AI Act Article 50. No personal data is collected by default. Export or delete your data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, Delaware, USA.
